|strategy=By Gregg Keefer, Gold 4<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040810091421/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/dagobah.html</ref>

This is by far one of the best choices for a starting loccation you can use for the Light Side as it gives HUGE Force generation in a hurry! You'll activate 2 Force (plus 1 for yourself) on your first turn and there is a tradeoff as it gives the same amount to your opponent but the card text of this location allows you to make this up every turn if you put additional Dagobah sites in your deck. During your deploy phase you may dig out any Dagobah site from your Reserve Deck and deploy it! This saves you the trouble of waiting to draw up sites to get the Force flowing. I only put one such site in my deck and that is [[Yoda]]'s Hut (2 Force for me and zip for them), on my first turn I deploy it and BAM, on my second turn I am activating 5 Force.

All the Dagobah sites are good for you and do nothing for your opponent but too many of them will restrict your Force drain options so I usually only put in one or two to get the Force flowing and then move on to my real strategy. These sites will keep your opponent off balance, thinking you are playing a Dagobah drain or Jedi Training deck when you are really going to Cloud City or [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]].

In addition to the Force generation, having these sites on the table lets you play Stone Piles and take 2 cards at random from your opponent's hand and place them in limbo on Dagobah. There is nothing sweeter than a lucky pick removing the [[Executor]] or some other vital card from their strategy early in the game! So come back to Dagobah. It's a slimy mudhole.

By Nicholas Cai<ref name="decipher-strategy" />

Nobody would have thought a location like this could help you win the game! It sort of works like this: use [[Dagobah (Light){{!}}Dagobah]]'s "search" ability and deploy a Dagobah location every turn. This guarantees you Force every turn! Use the extra Force to deploy characters, and this also gives you complete card drawing advantage! It works well with any deck. Best of all, [[Yoda]] would have a place to deploy to (at his hut, he subtracts 2 from attrition!) . The possibilities are just endless.
